q1.sampleAnswer: Because the youngest of its members are just learning to walk, and it’s too early to predict their future.

keyPoints.descZh: 最小的成员才刚学走路（还太小，无法预测他们的未来）
examples: the youngest of its members are just learning to walk
it’s too early to predict their future

q1.rubricZh: 要点：Alpha一代最小的孩子才刚学走路，还无法预测他们的未来。
q1.explanationZh: 第三段说科学家们都认为现在下结论太早，因为这一代最小的孩子才刚学会走路，还看不出他们长大后的样子。

evidence.quote: After all, the youngest of its members are just learning to walk.

q2.sampleAnswer: Not until at least five years later.

examples: Not until at least five years later

q2.explanationZh: 第四段最后一句说 Duffy 认为至少五年以后，才会开始看到 Alpha 一代和别人的真正差别。

evidence.quote: Duffy believes we won’t start seeing real differences between Alphas and the others for at least five years.

q3.sampleAnswer: “The restless” refers to Generation Alpha. The author uses “restless” because they are still in their developmental years, and their attitudes and values will keep changing as they grow up.

keyPoints.descZh: 因为他们还在成长阶段，态度和价值观会不断变化
examples: they are still in their developmental years
their attitudes and values will keep changing as they grow up

q3.rubricZh: 要点：①指Alpha一代；②原因：他们还处在成长阶段，态度和价值观还会不断变化。
q3.explanationZh: 标题里的 the Young and the Restless 说的是 Alpha 一代。第四段说他们还在成长期，想法和价值观会变，所以用 restless（不安定）。

evidence.quote: But no one can deny that Alphas are in their developmental years.
People’s attitudes and values will change as they grow up.

q4.sampleAnswer: I was born in 2010, so I’m among the oldest Alphas. I’d like to use the word “digital” to describe my generation because we have grown up with lots of digital devices, and we are really good at using them. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 说明自己是不是Alpha一代成员（可结合出生年份）
examples: I was born in 2010, so I’m among the oldest Alphas.
Yes, I am a member of Gen Alpha.

keyPoints.descZh: 用合理的词或理由描述自己这一代
examples: I’d like to use the word “digital” to describe my generation because we have grown up with lots of digital devices.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题：①说明自己是否属于Alpha一代；②用合理的词语加理由描述自己这一代。言之有理即可。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先根据出生年份说明自己是不是 Alpha 一代，再用一个词加理由来描述你们这一代，合理就行。

evidence.quote: McCrindle thinks the group should include those born between 2010 and 2024.
